target_user: Households sharing replacement consumables across several appliances
problem: Separate maintenance reminders do not show pooled stock and the quantity to buy for upcoming replacements
product_promise: Know the exact refill, shared stock and purchase gap before the next household supply run
core_loop: Define supply and manual fit notes → link appliances → plan 30/60/90-day demand → receive stock → replace and deduct → undo mistakes → export or restore
durable_output: Local supply ledger, pooled purchase plan, portable JSON backup and plain-text shopping list
platform: Flutter iOS 15+, Android API 24+; compile/target 36; current official upload requirements evaluated separately
language_behavior: 默认跟随系统；匹配支持的系统语言，无法匹配时回退英文；仅持久化用户显式选择，选择跟随系统时清除覆盖
appearance_behavior: 默认跟随系统 light/dark；仅持久化用户显式选择，选择跟随系统时清除覆盖
app_icon_direction: Original folded refill loop in a plum square, reproducible vector source
launch_experience: iOS/Android 原生启动页；与首个 Flutter 页面及系统 light/dark 连续；无动态或本地化文案、广告、假进度和人为延时
onboarding_behavior: 原生启动后显示；首次安装可跳过；完成或跳过后持久化并在后续启动直达首页；可从设置或帮助重新查看且不重置完成状态
existing_user_onboarding: 新项目无既有用户；改造已发布项目时默认不强制既有用户重新进入引导，除非 PRD 明确要求
scroll_bottom_inset: 滚动视口使用可用空间；在滚动内容尾部按当前系统底部安全区动态留量，不固定分割页面且不重复计算底部占用
dialog_style: 默认使用 iOS/Cupertino 风格弹框与操作层级
monetization: 免费且无 IAP；如有变化必须重新审核
backend_model: 离线优先，无应用自有后台
data_handling: Local JSON in app support; user-selected system file import and explicit share. No network SDK, account, analytics or ads. OS backup/file providers and destinations may use cloud.
sensitive_data: Household device labels and notes may be personal; no health or safety advice
permissions: System file picker on explicit import; no broad storage, camera or notification permission
minimum_ios_assumption: iOS15 product baseline, not the required iOS26 upload SDK
visual_direction: Warm paper, deep plum ink, apricot accents; shared-stock planning workbench with compact lists and timeline
forbidden_actions: 不创建或修改生产证书和账号
name_clearance: Fylqo rejected after user confirmed existing use. Refqo public exact/Apple/Play queries had no app matches on 2026-10-21. Unpublished reservations and trademark clearance unverified; no store record created.
